en.answer:
If you cannot enter the Battle Phase during the current turn, such as because it is the first turn of the Duel, or because it is the Main Phase 2 or End Phase, or because you cannot enter the Battle Phase due to some card effect or text, the effect of <<11414>> cannot be activated.

Additionally, you cannot activate the effect of <<11414>> by targeting a monster that currently cannot attack, such as due to the effect of <<4354>>. (Note that if the monster is capable of attacking, such as because it is unaffected by Spell effects, it can be targeted.)

However, in cases where you can attempt to enter the Battle Phase, even if that Battle Phase would then be skipped (such as by the effect of <<5793>>), you can still activate the effect of <<11414>>.

~~~

The same also applies to the following cards or effects:

Effect monsters' effects:
● <<10242>>'s ③rd effect
● <<14950>>'s ③rd effect
● <<17421>>'s ②nd effect

Fusion Monsters' effects:
● <<16730>>'s ②nd effect

Xyz Monsters' effects:
● <<20784>>'s ①st effect
● <<10529>>'s ②nd effect
● <<9915>>'s ①st effect
● <<20411>>'s bulleted (●) effect
● <<13017>>'s ③rd effect

Link Monsters' effects:
● <<14122>>'s ②nd effect
● <<19414>>'s ①st effect
● <<19383>>'s ②nd effect

Spell/Trap effects:
● <<11902>>'s effect
● <<13437>>'s ②nd effect
en.question:
Can I activate the ①st effect of <<11414>>, which allows the targeted monster to make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn, if you cannot perform the Battle Phase during your current turn. (For example, because it is the first turn of the Duel, or because you cannot perform your Battle Phase due to some card, or because it is the Main Phase 2 or later.)

Additionally, can I activate that effect of <<11414>> if the targeted monster currently cannot attack due to an effect such as that of <<4354>>?
en.title: Can I activate a『it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn』effect during a turn in which the Battle Phase has already been conducted, during a turn during which the Battle Phase cannot be conducted, or if the monster in question cannot attack?

ja.answer:
ターン中にバトルフェイズを行うことがない状況では発動できません。また、「<<4354>>」等の効果によって攻撃できない状態のモンスターを対象として「<<11414>>」の効果を発動することはできません。（魔法カードの効果を受けない等により攻撃できる状態のモンスターであれば対象として発動することができます。）

なお、「<<5793>>」の効果が適用されているなどの理由で、バトルフェイズに移行しようとすることはできるものの、そのバトルフェイズがスキップされる状況で、「<<11414>>」の効果を発動することは可能です。

例として、以下の効果も同様です。

「<<14950>>」③
「<<17421>>」②

融合モンスター
「<<16730>>」②

エクシーズモンスター
「<<20784>>」①
「<<10529>>」②
「<<9915>>」①
「<<20411>>」●
「<<13017>>」③

リンクモンスター
「<<14122>>」②
「<<19414>>」①
「<<19383>>」②

魔法・罠
「<<11902>>」
「<<13437>>」②
